text: I noticed the mass in my left breast about four weeks ago, and it has grown quite rapidly since then. text: Given the rapid growth and fixed nature of the mass, I need to assess for lymphatic involvement. Have you noticed any lumps in your armpit or above your collarbone, or any changes in your menstrual cycle?

text: Do you have any family history of breast or ovarian cancer, and have you ever had a biopsy or imaging of this area before? I also need to know if you are currently pregnant or breastfeeding, as this can influence the differential diagnosis.

text:
